doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: De De's trip toward Mexico while in Texas
summary: De De says he never reached California but was heading to Mexico when his band split in Fort Worth after an uncle died in a Mexican mine.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: I'm just wondering, D.D., did you ever get to California?
No, I never did. No, we never did get to California.
It didn't have you all that got out that far.
Well, during the time I was in Texas, I was to go to Mexico. My uncle died. My uncle died in Mexico. He got a cruise, you know?

Yeah, and during the time I was on over with the band, well, I was across the Rye Grand and I had wrote my father here for his address, because during the time my father was living, they communicated with one another once or twice a year they'd write to each other, you know? And I was together to make that trip over there. The band split up during the time we were in Fort Worth or somewhere around in there. Did he play?
He was in the mine, kind of mining operations like mining, you know, silver mine I believe in Mexico.
